name: 64505 · Saint Joseph, MO
findings: ZIP 64505 (Saint Joseph) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64505 (Saint Joseph) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 64505 (Saint Joseph) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).
